newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - March 27.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - March 27.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The low in natural float occurred on Friday at about $200 million. The high in natural float was about $1.0 billion on Tuesday.
Transporation float averaged about $10 million per day with the high on Wednesday at a bit under $50 million primarily due to cancelled flights from the Northeast to the Southeast and Midwest.
